query:
SELECT m.id, m.conversationId, m.role, LEFT(m.content, 50) as content_preview, m.createdAt
FROM messages m
WHERE m.conversationId IN (
  SELECT c.id FROM conversations c 
  WHERE c.userId = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'test@example.com' LIMIT 1)
  ORDER BY c.createdAt DESC 
  LIMIT 2
)
ORDER BY m.conversationId DESC, m.createdAt ASC;
